rca of the issue: Original bug: PHP code was placed inside .html block-theme template parts, which WordPress renders as literal text (block templates only accept block markup, not PHP). Fix applied by main agent: relocated all PHP into patterns/*.php files (patterns support PHP), and replaced parts/header.html + parts/footer.html with a single <!-- wp:pattern {slug:...} /--> reference. Verified via static filesystem inspection—no runtime WP available.
